name: project-plateau-promo-video
description: Reproducible Remotion project for the Project Plateau launch video.

scripts.studio: npm run assets && remotion studio src/index.jsx
scripts.render: npm run verify:voiceover && npm run assets && remotion render src/index.jsx ProjectPlateauPromo out/project-plateau-promo-36s-remotion.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --audio-codec=aac && node scripts/finalize-output.mjs
